name: pf-mod-colors
about: mod-colors against the built package qol instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). mods/colors tints real projectiles (class_swaps, not the ignored info.xml classmaps): hwp colors contrast, a spawned undead guard sentry shoots its crossbow at the player (god mode), and the first tinted shot is logged as enemy #ff5959. Then no script errors in our files.
